sql: WITH cust AS ( SELECT pty_id, org_id FROM ads_cust_info_d WHERE data_dt = '20260531' ), branch AS ( SELECT up_org_name, org_name, org_id FROM dim_branch WHERE data_dt = '20260531' ), customer_base AS ( SELECT c.pty_id, b.up_org_name, b.org_name FROM cust c INNER JOIN branch b ON c.org_id = b.org_id ), asset_data AS ( SELECT pty_id, COALESCE(nm_tot_aset,0) + COALESCE(fc_pur_aset,0) AS total_asset FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt = '20260331' ), tran_agg AS ( SELECT pty_id, SUM(COALESCE(buy_amt,0) + COALESCE(sell_amt,0)) AS qtr_turnover, SUM(COALESCE(buy_rake,0) + COALESCE(buy_fare,0) + COALESCE(sell_rake,0) + COALESCE(sell_fare,0)) AS qtr_total_fee FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id ), fin_agg AS ( SELECT pty_id, SUM(COALESCE(cash_in,0) - COALESCE(cash_out,0)) AS qtr_net_inflow FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id ), hold_agg AS ( SELECT pty_id, SUM(COALESCE(mkt_val,0)) AS hold_mkt_val FROM dwd_cust_hold_d WHERE data_dt = '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id ), branch_metrics AS ( SELECT cb.up_org_name, cb.org_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cb.pty_id) AS customer_count, SUM(COALESCE(ad.total_asset,0)) AS total_asset, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(ta.qtr_turnover,0) > 0 THEN cb.pty_id END) AS active_count, SUM(COALESCE(ta.qtr_turnover,0)) AS turnover, SUM(COALESCE(ta.qtr_total_fee,0)) AS total_fee, SUM(COALESCE(fa.qtr_net_inflow,0)) AS net_inflow, SUM(COALESCE(ha.hold_mkt_val,0)) AS holding_market_value FROM customer_base cb LEFT JOIN asset_data ad ON cb.pty_id = ad.pty_id LEFT JOIN tran_agg ta ON cb.pty_id = ta.pty_id LEFT JOIN fin_agg fa ON cb.pty_id = fa.pty_id LEFT JOIN hold_agg ha ON cb.pty_id = ha.pty_id GROUP BY cb.up_org_name, cb.org_name ), ranked AS ( SELECT up_org_name, org_name, customer_count, total_asset, CASE WHEN customer_count > 0 THEN active_count * 1.0 / customer_count ELSE 0.0 END AS active_customer_rate, turnover, total_fee, net_inflow, holding_market_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY up_org_name ORDER BY total_asset DESC) AS asset_rank_in_company FROM branch_metrics ) SELECT up_org_name, org_name, customer_count, total_asset, active_customer_rate, turnover, total_fee, net_inflow, holding_market_value, asset_rank_in_company FROM ranked WHERE asset_rank_in_company <= 3 ORDER BY up_org_name ASC, asset_rank_in_company ASC
